description: The file 'planEdit.php' is a PHP script that manages test plans within the TestLink open-source test management tool. It handles creating, updating, deleting, and displaying test plans, as well as managing attachments and user permissions. The script interacts with the database, templates, and user sessions to facilitate test plan administration.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class representing a test plan, used for managing test plan data, linked custom fields, and related operations.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class representing a test project, used for retrieving project-specific configurations and data.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the system, handling role and rights management.
